content.description:
<untrusted_participant_content>
Project Overview
We’re looking for an experienced Full-Stack AI Developer to help us design, develop, and launch an innovative fintech platform with web and mobile applications, powered by intelligent AI automations.
 
The ideal candidate combines strong full-stack engineering skills with hands-on experience building AI-powered applications, workflow automations, API integrations, and secure financial technology solutions. We need someone who can take ownership of the project from architecture and development through testing, deployment, and ongoing improvements.
 
Responsibilities
Web & Mobile App Development: Build scalable, responsive web applications and mobile apps for iOS and Android.
AI Integration: Develop and integrate AI-powered features using OpenAI, LLMs, AI agents, and other relevant AI technologies.
AI Automation: Design intelligent workflows to automate repetitive tasks, business processes, data processing, notifications, and decision-support operations.
Full-Stack Engineering: Develop robust frontend interfaces, backend services, APIs, databases, and third-party integrations.
Fintech Integrations: Implement financial APIs, payment gateways, transaction workflows, and other fintech-related services as required.
Security & Reliability: Follow best practices for authentication, authorization, data protection, secure API design, and financial data handling.
Deployment & Maintenance: Manage testing, bug fixing, cloud deployment, monitoring, and performance optimization.
Required Skills & Experience
Proven experience as a Full-Stack Developer building production-ready web and mobile applications.
Strong expertise in AI integrations, LLMs, AI agents, and intelligent automation workflows.
Experience with OpenAI APIs, prompt engineering, and AI-powered application development.
Proficiency in modern frontend and backend technologies such as React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, or equivalent.
Experience developing mobile applications using Flutter, React Native, or native technologies.
Strong knowledge of REST APIs, databases, authentication, cloud infrastructure, and third-party integrations.
Experience with fintech, payments, financial applications, or other security-sensitive platforms.
Ability to translate business requirements into a practical technical architecture and deliver production-ready solutions.
Nice to Have
Experience with workflow automation platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier.
Experience building AI agents, multi-step AI workflows, and tool/API-calling systems.
Knowledge of financial data integrations, transaction reconciliation, fraud detection, or risk analytics.
Experience with AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Firebase, or Supabase.
Familiarity with financial compliance requirements relevant to the target market.
What We’re Looking For
We want a proactive developer who can think beyond writing code. You should be comfortable understanding business requirements, recommending the right technology stack, identifying potential risks, and building a scalable solution.
You should be able to explain technical decisions clearly, work independently, communicate consistently, and prioritize security and reliability throughout development.
 
To Apply
Please include the following in your proposal:
A brief introduction highlighting your full-stack, AI automation, and fintech experience.
Links to 2-3 relevant projects you have personally developed or contributed to, especially AI-powered applications or fintech platforms.
The technologies and architecture you would recommend for this project.
Your experience building AI agents, workflow automations, and web/mobile applications.
Your estimated availability, hourly rate or project-based pricing, and a realistic initial delivery timeline.
A short explanation of how you would approach security and sensitive financial data.
Bonus: Share one example of an AI automation you built that solved a real business problem.
 
We’re looking for someone who can become a reliable technical partner and help us turn this fintech concept into a secure, intelligent, and scalable product.
 
If you’re the right fit, we look forward to hearing from you!
</untrusted_participant_content>
content.title: Full-Stack AI Developer - Fintech Mobile & Web App + AI Automation Expert
